snippet.title: The Voice Talent of TMNT: Splintered Fate - Extended Edition
snippet.description:
Our Voice Talent team discusses the King's Gambit Update and the big reveal at the end of it. Watch Yuri Lowenthal, Dale Inghram, Roger Craig Smith, Dominic Catrambone, and many more discuss the secret plan of the Rat King himself, Rick Pasqualone!

Want even more secret lore? We’ve released another Extended Version focused on the Narrative, packed with extra quotes and behind-the-scenes secrets. Check it our on our channel!
